items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Juan Tizol suing Perez Prado; INTERVIEWEE confirms 'That's true. It was.'

ctx.x: Well, I guess Duke was a bigger man than a lot of people realize, in a lot of ways. Because he didn't have to let it go. He just said, "What the hell. It can't hurt me that much."
